name: Выбрать всё
examples: SELECT * FROM users
SELECT * FROM orders
SELECT * FROM logs

name: Уникальные значения
examples: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM users
SELECT DISTINCT age FROM users
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM users

name: Псевдоним и лимит
examples: SELECT name AS n FROM users LIMIT 10
SELECT age AS a FROM users LIMIT 5
SELECT id AS i FROM users LIMIT 1

name: Фильтр WHERE
examples: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > 18
SELECT * FROM users WHERE city IN ('MSK','SPB')
SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'A%'

name: Сортировка ORDER BY
examples: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age DESC
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY city, age DESC

name: Группировка GROUP BY
examples: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city
SELECT city, AVG(age) FROM users GROUP BY city
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

name: JOIN
examples: SELECT * FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
SELECT * FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
SELECT * FROM users u RIGHT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id

name: INSERT
examples: INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES ('Аня', 25)
INSERT INTO users SELECT * FROM temp_users
INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Аня') RETURNING id

name: UPDATE
examples: UPDATE users SET age = 26 WHERE id = 1
UPDATE users SET age = age + 1
UPDATE users SET name = 'Аня' WHERE id = 1 RETURNING *

name: DELETE
examples: DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1
DELETE FROM users WHERE age < 18 RETURNING *
TRUNCATE TABLE users

name: CREATE TABLE
examples: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL, user_id INT REFERENCES users(id))
CREATE TABLE logs (id SERIAL, msg TEXT NOT NULL)

name: ALTER TABLE
examples: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email TEXT
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email
ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN name TO full_name

name: Индексы
examples: CREATE INDEX idx_users_name ON users(name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email)
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_user ON orders(user_id)

name: EXPLAIN
examples: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM users
EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM users

name: CTE (WITH)
examples: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM users) SELECT * FROM t
WITH a AS (...), b AS (...) SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON ...
WITH RECURSIVE t AS (...) SELECT * FROM t

name: Оконные функции
examples: SELECT name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age) FROM users
SELECT name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY age DESC) FROM users
SELECT name, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) FROM orders

name: Транзакции
examples: BEGIN; UPDATE ...; COMMIT;
BEGIN; UPDATE ...; ROLLBACK;
SAVEPOINT sp1; ... ROLLBACK TO sp1;
